# Conviso Platform Documentation Expanded Index

Conviso Platform is a cloud-based application security platform. It brings together application inventory, risk context, vulnerability management, application security testing, secure design, offensive testing operations, integrations, and AI-assisted workflows.

## Evaluation and product information

- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/before-you-buy — Evaluation guide for security, engineering, IT, procurement, and compliance stakeholders.
- https://www.convisoappsec.com/conviso-platform — Product overview and primary use cases.
- https://www.convisoappsec.com/platform/pricing — Public plan and pricing information.
- https://www.convisoappsec.com/contact — Contact Conviso for a demo or commercial discussion.

## Risk and vulnerability operations

- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/posture-management/posture — Risk and posture management.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/posture-management/aspm-coverage — ASPM coverage dashboard.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/posture-management/vulnerability-kpi — Vulnerability KPIs.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/vulnerability-management/process — Vulnerability management workflow.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/vulnerability-management/workflow-status — Vulnerability lifecycle statuses.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/vulnerability-management/remediation-sla — Remediation SLA configuration.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/platform/security-feed — Security Feed overview.

## Security testing and delivery

- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/conviso-ast/ — Conviso AST: SAST, SCA, IaC, SBOM, secret, and container analysis.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/conviso-dast/ — Conviso DAST for web applications and APIs.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/conviso-sbom/ — SBOM generation and visibility.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/conviso-containers/ — Container security analysis.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/pull-requests/ — Pull request scanning.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/security-gate — Security Gate in CI/CD.
- https://docs.convisoappsec.com/security-scans/reachability-analysis — Reachability analysis for SCA findings.
